decisions.text: Claude wrote the shared sprite player and tokens so both lanes animate and label states the same way.
Worker stations get the role of the station (builder, artist, reviewer); assignment is sticky by lane id with an overflow list.
Old SVG sprite system and its layout/motion/sprite checks are retired with Office v2.

Both lanes timed out at 90 min after step 6/8. Claude fixed sprite positioning (missing position:absolute) and relaunched continuation lanes office-v2b and lanes-v2b with screenshot bugs + test hook + self check, LANE_TIMEOUT 7200.
A time limit is a safeguard, not a failure: lanes that hit LANE_TIMEOUT now end Paused (exit 5) and `ca lane --resume` continues them in place; plan lanes can say continues:<task>.
Continued lanes fold into their successor (one agent, one station); open tabs self-reload via /api/ui so deployed fixes show without a manual refresh.
Office stage fills the whole page below the header at any aspect (cover fit that keeps every station visible); steered office-v2b.
office-v2b: gates green; reviewer's 3 findings overruled (they contradict the lead's two steers: cover-fit stage, continuation line). Claude fixed the narrow stage height and its check.
Merged lanes-v2 and office-v2; post-merge: compact window step titles, folded lanes off the rail. 9 checks green; deployed.

risks: GLM has no image input: Claude judges the screenshots against the mockups.
Snapshot diffs drive cues: first load and reconnect must not replay effects.
